decisive_items: Seventeen days after her last day of chemotherapy, while neutropenic, she became febrile
Several vesicles with an erythematous base were observed on the lower back and left thigh
Hematoxylin-eosin stain showed focal epidermal and subepidermal necrosis with numerous filamentous bacilli with septa
Gram stain revealed numerous gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis
response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it specifically matches the clinical presentation and histopathological findings, including the characteristic skin lesions and gram-variable rods, which are consistent with Ecthyma gangrenosum, a known complication of Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection in immunocompromised patients.

rejected.why: lacks specific clinical and histopathological findings to support the diagnosis of neutropenic sepsis
necrotizing fasciitis is not supported by the presence of gram-variable rods and filamentous bacilli with septa
Bacillus anthracis infection is less likely given the clinical context and the presence of gram-variable rods, which are more consistent with Pseudomonas aeruginosa
